note: Nedbank: its rates page, last published 25 September 2026 in line with the repo rate, gives the Nedbank Gold Credit Card 21.25% a year; its 2026 fee schedule, effective 1 January 2026, charges the new Gold card a R42 monthly maintenance fee and a credit facility service fee of R23 that varies with the holder's risk profile up to R69, written at its top. Capitec's rates page answered with a bot check, and Standard Bank's 2026 card pricing guide redirected to its homepage; neither was read.
